title: Rail-Optimized AI Datacenter Services Input (fragment)
description: Overlay services for the frontend/storage fabric. The backend fabric takes no service input: the Backend CR derives its own per-rail services from the stripes and the GPU VLAN. Fragment variant: top-level required keys removed so individual fragments under inputs/*.d/ validate cleanly. The merged result is still validated against the strict schema.

bridge_domain.description: Bridge domain this VLAN belongs to (must exist in bridge_domains).

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID ('untagged' or numeric string like '10').

interface_selector.description: Label selectors to match interfaces for this VLAN.

mac_learning.description: Whether the bridge domain learns MACs from the data plane.

bridge_domains.description: MAC-VRF bridge domains in the frontend namespace.

vlans.description: VLAN services attaching bridge domains to the server LAGs. Selectors match the tagged-v<vlan> / untagged-v<vlan> labels the builder puts on each LAG.
